gen-fs-quilon-gf-amiko: Quilon leads with editorial authority, robust downstrokes giving way to slender turns in a steady tide. Amiko sits below with crayon-thick lowercase and terminals that flare outward, modern and low in contrast.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-anek-devanagari: Commanding and editorial, Quilon thins its strokes only moderately, like letters stamped in soft metal, with generous open counters. Quilon makes the statement; Anek Devanagari handles the sentences, with open letter mouths.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads clean and approachable, its wide bowls setting the rhythm and its rounds staying unsealed. And Quilon adds editorial command up top, its middling contrast like a flat brush held half-turned.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-arimo: Soft-marker swell, editorial nerve: that is Quilon, leading with a mild thickening in every stroke. And Arimo, a sans with a high mean line and spacious terminal gaps, is the pair's standout.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-biryani: Biryani keeps every stroke like a pencil line, with no thickness shift. Quilon brings the editorial command, its thins never turning spindly, while Biryani's large eyes and unclogged counters keep the text approachable.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-cascadia-code: Modern and wire-like, Cascadia Code never shifts its stroke weight. Give Quilon the larger size and let Cascadia Code stay modest, since its wide spacing and smooth bends carry on their own.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-cascadia-mono: Commanding and editorial, Quilon leads with a noticeable yet modest thick-thin difference. Cascadia Mono then reads in compact, pin-straight rows where capitals blend into lowercase, its curves matching its stems in weight.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-chivo: Quilon announces itself with editorial command, its stroke weight sitting comfortably midway between flat and dramatic. Chivo packs lowercase near the caps and lets daylight through each curve.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-chocolate-classical-san: Quilon speaks in editorial tones, with a sensible thick-thin difference. Chocolate Classical Sans settles in beneath with a sizable lowercase and broad-nibbed strokes that never curl shut, so paragraphs move along comfortably.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans gives small letters generous openings, their bodies dominating the line while ascenders hardly show. Duru Sans lets Quilon's commanding, softly shifting strokes lead, while staying low in contrast itself.
